description: This source file contains an extension for the ChannelsStore class, adding asynchronous lifecycle management methods such as start, stop, refresh, and methods for handling WhatsApp and Telegram login/logout processes. It manages asynchronous tasks, network requests through GatewayConnection, and maintains state related to channel status and login sessions.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginStartResult
classes.description: Represents the result of starting a WhatsApp login session, including the QR code URL and a message.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginWaitResult
classes.description: Represents the result of waiting for WhatsApp login confirmation, indicating connection status and a message.

classes.name: ChannelLogoutResult
classes.description: Contains the outcome of a logout request for a specific channel, including whether credentials were cleared.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins polling for channel status updates if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the polling task for channel status updates.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest status snapshot from the server, updating internal state.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Initiates WhatsApp login process, optionally auto-waiting for user confirmation.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for the user to complete WhatsApp login within a specified timeout.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out of WhatsApp channel, clearing session data.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out of Telegram channel, clearing session or token details.
